title: What is it like to work in the film industry? – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: What is it like to work in the film industry? – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension practice test for pre-advanced students (CEFR B2 level). Working in the film industry. English listening test.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Listen to an interview with a man who works in the film industry, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.
See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: What does Jack say about finding work?

choices.html: It has become easier since he got more experience.
His qualifications have helped him to get work.
Despite his experience, it has not got any easier.

questions.prompt: What does Jack say about working on a film set?

choices.html: He must always be ready to work.
He is always waiting for other people.

questions.prompt: According to Jack, only the most successful people in the film industry are...
Jack says that to remain in the film industry, you should avoid...
When working in close contact with other film workers, Jack...

choices.html: tries to keep his bad habits to himself.
likes that everyone is free to be themselves.

questions.prompt: If someone uses language that you don't understand, Jack recommends that you...

choices.html: work out what is required by yourself.
ask the person to explain what they mean.
